hypotheses.claim: Rating-date alone is sufficient to treat same-day Taiwan equity open/close as informed.
hypotheses.support: Official agency history gives dated directional rating events.
hypotheses.counterevidence: The 22-anchor manifest has zero explicit intraday release timestamps; rating date and first publicly observable time are distinct.
hypotheses.alternative: The actual press release could have appeared before, during or after trading hours.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Without independent publication timestamp, same-day decision eligibility cannot be attested.

hypotheses.claim: 22 episode anchors are 22 statistically independent credit shocks.
hypotheses.support: The frozen rule separates 22 directional episodes on 22 distinct dates.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Only 10 issuers contribute; three cross-issuer pairs fall within seven calendar days; issuer and macro shocks can be correlated.
hypotheses.alternative: Sector/macro news and issuer-specific repeated rating cycles create dependence.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Independence unsupported without issuer clustering, date/regime controls and holdout.

hypotheses.claim: Current agency rating page can be used as historical eligibility and default label.
hypotheses.support: Issuer history preserves some past rating states.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Wiwynn 2026-08-25 NR/withdrawal at issuer request proves current rating coverage may change; NR is not default.
hypotheses.alternative: Issuer requested withdrawal; no credit deterioration established.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Current-header state or withdrawn status backfilled to 2021/2023 episodes.

hypotheses.claim: 11 positive and 11 negative episodes imply unbiased direction balance.
hypotheses.support: Frozen manifest has equal directional episode counts.
hypotheses.counterevidence: Sample was collected from selected rated nonfinancial issuers; no complete rated-issuer/withdrawn-issuer denominator.
hypotheses.alternative: Availability of historical rating pages, event publication and issuer survival determine inclusion.
hypotheses.failureCondition: Interpreting 11/11 as representative probability or predictive effect.
